decisive_items: T1-hypointense, STIR-hyperintense lesion with a thick sclerotic rim in the anterolateral cortex of the left femoral head
mild to moderate chronic synovitis with lymphoplasmacytic infiltrates
response.rationale: The imaging shows a well-defined sclerotic-rim lesion typical of CRMO, with sterile chronic synovitis and no response to anti-tubercular therapy, ruling out infection. Synovial sarcoma would show malignant histology and different imaging, not chronic lymphoplasmacytic synovitis.

rejected.why: No malignant features; histology is chronic synovitis, not sarcoma; imaging lacks tumor mass.
Negative cultures and no clinical improvement on anti-tubercular therapy contradict tuberculous arthritis.
